yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: demo-app
  annotations:
    image.openshift.io/triggers: '[{"from":{"kind":"ImageStreamTag","name":"demo-app:latest"},"fieldPath":"spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.name==\"demo-app\")].image"}]'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: demo-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: demo-app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: demo-app
          image: image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000/demo-project/demo-app:latest
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: demo-app-config
            - secretRef:
                name: demo-app-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: registry-credentials
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: demo-app-data
